scope_basis.heading: ## 14.2 Architecture: Kernel Binding and Engine Crates
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-ARC-001] `handshake_core::studio` is the integrated authority binding, not the owner of compute/domain implementations. It MUST receive the existing `AppState` shared SurrealDB client, model, sandbox, PromotionGate and CRDT infrastructure by reference and register typed Studio API routes in the existing API owner; it MUST NOT initialize duplicate infrastructure. Independently selectable asset leaf crates own domain algorithms, shared document/contracts, reusable controls and provider adapters through typed ports. Their immutable inputs and proposed outputs carry canonical schemas, IDs, units and resource context; only the kernel binding may persist accepted integrated authority through the existing governed lifecycle. Concrete source paths and crate owners MUST be declared in the activated contracts rather than inferred from legacy `src/studio/<domain>/` examples. The existing `StudioEngineError` identifier and typed error semantics, `event_family` constants and canonical event-family values MUST be preserved at the named kernel-binding contract owner. Moving files or splitting providers MUST NOT silently remove or rename these contracts. The activated module/MT map MUST explicitly locate their definitions and API registration consumer, while retaining `storage_glue` responsibility at the binding without forcing legacy directory topology.

The existing RasterEngine, VectorEngine, LayoutEngine, TextEngine, ColorEngine and RenderEngine contract semantics remain preserved; new domain ports MUST be specified in canonical contracts before implementation. Contract/document crates MUST NOT depend on provider implementations, kernel, native shell, database, GPU or codec runtimes. No mandatory all-engine dependency facade is permitted.

scope_basis.heading: ## 14.2 Architecture: Kernel Binding and Engine Crates
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-ARC-001] `handshake_core::studio` is the integrated authority binding, not the owner of compute/domain implementations. It MUST receive the existing `AppState` shared SurrealDB client, model, sandbox, PromotionGate and CRDT infrastructure by reference and register typed Studio API routes in the existing API owner; it MUST NOT initialize duplicate infrastructure. Independently selectable asset leaf crates own domain algorithms, shared document/contracts, reusable controls and provider adapters through typed ports. Their immutable inputs and proposed outputs carry canonical schemas, IDs, units and resource context; only the kernel binding may persist accepted integrated authority through the existing governed lifecycle. Concrete source paths and crate owners MUST be declared in the activated contracts rather than inferred from legacy `src/studio/<domain>/` examples. The existing `StudioEngineError` identifier and typed error semantics, `event_family` constants and canonical event-family values MUST be preserved at the named kernel-binding contract owner. Moving files or splitting providers MUST NOT silently remove or rename these contracts. The activated module/MT map MUST explicitly locate their definitions and API registration consumer, while retaining `storage_glue` responsibility at the binding without forcing legacy directory topology.

scope_basis.heading: ## 14.2 Architecture: Kernel Binding and Engine Crates
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-ARC-002] `handshake_core` MUST NOT gain Studio GPU/compute implementation dependencies. GPU, CPU render, raster, vector, layout, text, color, RAW, sequence, audio, motion, composition and import/export providers MUST be independently selectable crates behind typed `Send + Sync` ports. The existing RasterEngine, VectorEngine, LayoutEngine, TextEngine, ColorEngine and RenderEngine contract semantics remain preserved; new domain ports MUST be specified in canonical contracts before implementation. Contract/document crates MUST NOT depend on provider implementations, kernel, native shell, database, GPU or codec runtimes. No mandatory all-engine dependency facade is permitted.

Asset leaf packages MUST compile and prove their declared dependency closures without requiring `handshake_core`, the native shell, SurrealDB, or unrelated Studio domains. Kernel-bound composition and integration proof MUST be scheduled separately and MUST preserve every integrated acceptance obligation. Governance remains in the live governance kernel.
